goals: Prove fleet-wide operational health against the contractual 98% Fleet Uptime target and SLA compliance
Diagnose recurring failure drivers (root cause, chronic devices) to target intervention
Evaluate the ZM management layer objectively (override quality, zone SLA outcomes)
scopeNote: PRD 61a-61e names Fleet Uptime, Root Cause Analytics, System Efficiency, ZM Scorecard, Device Detail/Downtime Trend. 'commissioning cohort' and 'CSM approval share' (from the survey scope line) are not named in PRD:188-198 or CONTEXT.md lines 1-369 read here -- carried as prd/role-derived candidates below, not textually anchored. Admin routes /reports/*, /exports imply a wider surface than the PRD prose enumerates.

capabilities.name: Fleet Uptime Report
capabilities.why: CONTEXT.md: 'the number that goes on company SLA reports' -- OH cannot answer 'are we meeting the master KPI' without it

capabilities.name: Soft Inactive Trend
capabilities.why: without it OH cannot tell whether Recommender deficit-mode flips reflect real backlog growth or noise

capabilities.name: SE Productivity report
capabilities.why: weekly workforce review needs this to catch overloaded/underperforming SEs and tune Daily Capacity

capabilities.name: Auto-Recovery Rate (separated from genuine repairs)
capabilities.why: CONTEXT.md: 'reports must separate auto-recoveries from genuine repairs' -- unseparated, SE productivity and component-consumption numbers are wrong (O3)

capabilities.name: Device Detail Downtime History
capabilities.why: PRD 61d -- without per-device failure history OH cannot diagnose a chronically unreliable device before replacing it

capabilities.name: Root-cause % distribution (structured field only)
capabilities.why: PRD 61b + CONTEXT.md 'structured root_cause_category, never free-text' -- main lever for fleet-wide intervention targeting; built from free text it is O3

capabilities.name: System Efficiency Report
capabilities.why: PRD 61c -- the whole system's ROI proof ('whether FSM reduces downtime and improves operations'); without it OH cannot justify the platform

capabilities.name: ZM Performance Scorecard
capabilities.why: PRD 61a -- OH's only lever to evaluate the management layer objectively; without it ZM overrides go unaudited

capabilities.name: Commissioning cohort report
capabilities.why: named only in the survey scope line, not grounded in CONTEXT.md/PRD read here -- likely an Install-Ticket cohort view; low confidence

capabilities.name: CSM approval / acting-role share
capabilities.why: CONTEXT.md: CSM acting-as-ZM actions are audited as acted_as_role=CENTRAL_SERVICE_MANAGER -- OH needs the acting-share visible or acting-scope abuse is invisible

capabilities.name: Exports (Finance voucher batch + report exports)
capabilities.why: SPINE E-17: voucher export is the only bridge to Finance reimbursement (no live integration) -- without it the monthly reimbursement batch cannot run

capabilities.name: Data-as-of freshness stamp on every report
capabilities.why: CONTEXT.md: 'all manager dashboards show a data-as-of timestamp' -- without it OH reads stale Snapshot-derived numbers as current (O3)

capabilities.name: Metric drill-through (summary number -> source tickets/audit rows)
capabilities.why: O-class taxonomy: a report number nobody can trace is O3 -- OH facing an SLA dispute must trace Fleet Uptime %/root-cause % back to source records or the metric is unverifiable
